龙国篇龙国篇第二十一章超凡（二）
王平的攻击如狂风骤雨般猛烈，每一道剑气都仿佛蕴含着天地之力，凌厉无匹。
那剑气在空中划出一道道耀眼的轨迹，犹如流星划破夜空，让人不敢直视。
诺克斯能够清晰地感受到那剑气中蕴含的恐怖力量，仿佛能够洞穿它的灵魂，将它彻底摧毁。
然而，作为魔龙族的王，诺克斯也绝非易于屈服之辈，它虽然心中惊恐，但并未失去斗志，只见它深吸一口气，口中的龙息瞬间变得更加狂猛，那龙息如同火山爆发般喷涌而出，化作一道巨大的火龙冲向王平，火龙所过之处，空气仿佛被点燃，发出噼里啪啦的声响。
王平见到此景，双眼猛地瞪大，一抹惊异之色迅速从他眼眸深处一闪而过，他清晰地感知到那条火龙中所蕴藏着的恐怖热量和磅礴力量，若是自己不幸被其正面击中，哪怕是以他自身如此强大的实力，恐怕也难以承受这等重创。
但是，面对这般骇人的威势，王平却没有丝毫退缩之意，相反，他内心深处的信念愈发坚定不移起来，只见他紧紧握住手中的长剑，手臂因为用力而微微颤抖着，一股雄浑无匹的气势自他体内喷涌而出，如同一座即将喷发的火山一般，瞬间将他整个人笼罩其中，并节节攀升至巅峰状态。
说时迟那时快！
就在这千钧一发的危急关头，王平毫不犹豫地挥动起手中那柄寒光闪烁的长剑。
刹那间，一道比之前更为凌厉、更为迅猛的剑气骤然激射而出，宛如闪电划破夜空般径直朝着那来势汹汹的火龙疾驰而去。
只听得“轰隆”
一声巨响，如同晴天霹雳一般响彻云霄，剑气与火龙在半空中轰然相撞，迸射出耀眼夺目的光芒，巨大的冲击波以两者撞击点为中心向着四面八方疯狂扩散开来。
一时间，整座城市都似乎被这股惊天动地的力量给深深震撼住了，无数棵参天大树在这股狂暴力量的冲击之下应声折断，粗壮的树干横七竖八地倒落一地；地面上更是扬起漫天尘土，遮天蔽日，让人几乎无法睁眼视物。
激烈的战斗仍在如火如荼地持续着，王平与诺克斯皆使出浑身解数，妄图一击制胜，彻底击溃对手。
只见他们的攻击如流星般划过天际，一次次在空中猛烈撞击，迸发出令人瞠目结舌的巨大能量，每一次惊天动地的碰撞，都犹如火山喷发一般，使得周遭的环境惨遭毁灭性打击，然而，这两位强者却仿若未觉，他们的目光始终紧紧锁定着彼此，眼中唯有对方的身影。
此时此刻，这场激战已绝非单纯的力量角逐那么简单，它已然升华为一场意志与信念之间惊心动魄的鏖战。
王平心中燃烧着坚定无比的信念，他誓要守护脚下这片广袤的土地以及生活于此的黎民百姓；而诺克斯亦是毫不退缩，一心想要捍卫属于自身的无上荣耀和尊崇地位，就这样，两人怀揣着各自坚定不移的目标，舍生忘死地奋勇搏杀，不管最终结局怎样，他们都毫无保留地将体内潜藏的所有力量激发至巅峰状态，全力以赴地投入到这场生死攸关的决斗之中。
随着时间一分一秒地流逝，这场激烈无比的战斗终于缓缓步入了白热化的阶段，只见王平手中的长剑舞动如风，其剑法愈发凌厉起来，每一剑挥出都带着破空之声，犹如雷霆万钧之势，令对面的诺克斯感受到一股前所未有的巨大压力。
面对如此威猛的攻势，诺克斯却丝毫不甘示弱，它张开那血盆大口，猛地喷出一道熊熊燃烧的龙息，这龙息比之前任何时候都要狂猛数倍不止，宛如一条咆哮着的火龙，张牙舞爪地扑向王平，似乎想要将眼前这个渺小的人类彻底吞噬殆尽。
然而，王平并没有被诺克斯的气势所吓倒，他深深地吸了一口气，仿佛要将整个世界的力量都尽数吸入自己的体内一般，紧接着，他紧紧握住剑柄，感受着剑身传来的那种冰凉而又坚定不移的触感，就好像这把剑已然成为了他心中最为坚实的信念与决心所在。

此时此刻，王平全神贯注，将自身所有的精气神都汇聚到了一起，并源源不断地注入到手中的长剑之中，他的眼神锐利如鹰隼，死死地盯着不远处的诺克斯，整个人散发出一种无与伦比的强大气场，只待时机一到，他便会毫不犹豫地施展出那足以决定胜负的致命一击！
刹那间，只见剑光如电芒般闪耀夺目，一道凌厉至极的剑气犹如脱缰野马一般，以迅雷不及掩耳之势直直奔向诺克斯，这惊世骇俗的一剑，乃是王平倾尽全身之力所发，其威力堪称毁天灭地，无与伦比！
那剑气在空气中急速划过，竟发出一阵尖锐刺耳的呼啸之声，宛如恶鬼哭号，又似万马奔腾，震耳欲聋。
此时此刻，时间仿佛凝固，万物皆为之停滞，面对如此恐怖的一击，诺克斯的双眼中不禁闪过一丝难以掩饰的惊恐之色，他拼命挥动着那双巨大而有力的翅膀，企图避开这致命的剑气，然而，一切都太晚了！
王平的剑气速度之快，尽管未能直接击中诺克斯的龙头，但却精准无误地斩落在了他那对宽阔坚实的双翼之上。
只听得“咔嚓”
一声脆响，诺克斯顿时发出一声响彻云霄的惨嚎，双翼上传来的剧痛犹如排山倒海般袭来，令他几近昏厥，由于失去了双翼的支撑，诺克斯庞大的身躯在空中瞬间失去了平衡，如同断了线的风筝一般，直直地朝着地面砸落下去。
伴随着轰然巨响，烟尘滚滚升腾而起，遮天蔽日，整个战场都因这突如其来的变故而陷入一片死寂，所有人都被这股惊天动地的力量所深深震撼，王平则静静地伫立在原地，目光紧紧锁定着诺克斯坠落的方向，眼神之中闪烁着坚定不移的光芒以及毅然决然的神色，此刻，他的内心同样充满了无尽的震撼与喜悦，因为他深知，自己刚才挥出的那一剑，不仅仅只是斩断了诺克斯的双翼那么简单，更是彻底斩断了长期以来一直萦绕心头的困扰、迷茫以及悲愤之情。
“师傅，我......做到了”

“也为您报了仇，也成为了，那个万中无一的至尊，人皇”
“人皇之力很强，强大到即使刚步入人皇，就已手握日月，斩尽星河”

Dragon Kingdom Chapter Dragon Kingdom Chapter 21 Extraordinary (2)
Wang Ping's attacks were as fierce as the violent wind and rain, and every sword energy seemed to contain the power of heaven and earth, and was unparalleled.
The sword energy drew dazzling trajectories in the air, like meteors cutting through the night sky, making people afraid to look directly at them.
Knox could clearly feel the terrifying power contained in the sword energy, as if it could penetrate its soul and completely destroy it.
However, as the king of the Demonic Dragon Clan, Knox is by no means someone who gives in easily. Although he was frightened, he did not lose his fighting spirit. He took a deep breath, and the dragon's breath in his mouth instantly became more violent. The dragon's breath spurted out like a volcanic eruption, turning into a huge fire dragon and rushing towards Wang Ping. Wherever the fire dragon passed, the air seemed to be ignited, making a crackling sound.
When Wang Ping saw this scene, his eyes suddenly widened, and a look of surprise flashed through the depths of his eyes. He clearly felt the terrifying heat and majestic power contained in the fire dragon. If he was unfortunate enough to be hit by it head-on, even with his own strength, he might not be able to withstand such a heavy blow.
However, in the face of such terrifying power, Wang Ping had no intention of flinching. On the contrary, the belief deep in his heart became more and more unswerving. He held the long sword tightly in his hand, his arms trembling slightly due to the exertion. A powerful aura spewed out from his body, like a volcano about to erupt, instantly enveloped his entire body and climbed to its peak state.
It's too late, it's faster than that!
At this critical moment, Wang Ping waved the long sword with cold light in his hand without hesitation.
In an instant, a sword energy that was sharper and faster than before suddenly shot out, speeding straight towards the menacing fire dragon like lightning piercing the night sky.
All I heard was "bang"
A loud noise resounded through the sky like a thunderbolt from the blue. The sword energy and the fire dragon collided in mid-air, bursting out with dazzling light. The huge shock wave spread crazily in all directions centered on the point of collision between the two.
For a moment, the entire city seemed to be deeply shaken by this earth-shattering force. Countless towering trees were broken under the impact of this violent force, and their thick trunks fell to the ground in random directions; dust was rising from the ground, blocking the sky and the sun, making it almost impossible to open your eyes and see.
The fierce battle was still going on in full swing. Both Wang Ping and Knox tried their best to win with one blow and completely defeat their opponents.
Their attacks were like meteors streaking across the sky, colliding violently in the air again and again, bursting out with jaw-dropping energy. Every earth-shattering collision was like a volcanic eruption, causing a devastating blow to the surrounding environment. However, these two strong men seemed not to notice. Their eyes were always locked on each other, with only each other's figures in their eyes.
At this moment, this fierce battle is no longer as simple as a simple competition of strength. It has been sublimated into a thrilling battle between will and belief.
Wang Ping's heart burned with unwavering belief, and he vowed to protect the vast land under his feet and the people living here; while Knox did not flinch, and wanted to defend his own supreme glory and respected status. In this way, the two of them held their own unswerving goals, risking their lives and fighting bravely. No matter what the final outcome, they unreservedly mobilized all the power hidden in their bodies to their peak state, and devoted themselves to this life-or-death duel.
As time passed by, this extremely fierce battle finally entered a fierce stage. The long sword in Wang Ping's hand was dancing like the wind, and his sword skills became more and more fierce. Every sword swing had the sound of breaking through the air, like the force of thunder., causing Knox on the opposite side to feel unprecedented pressure.
Faced with such a powerful offensive, Knox was not to be outdone at all. It opened its bloody mouth and spit out a blazing dragon's breath. This dragon's breath was several times more violent than ever before. Like a roaring fire dragon, it rushed towards Wang Ping with its teeth and claws, as if it wanted to completely devour the tiny human in front of it.
However, Wang Ping was not intimidated by Knox's momentum. He took a deep breath, as if he wanted to suck all the power of the world into his body. Then, he held the hilt of the sword tightly, feeling the cold yet unwavering touch from the sword, as if the sword had become the most solid belief and determination in his heart.
At this moment, Wang Ping was concentrating, gathering all his energy and spirit together, and pouring it into the long sword in his hand. His eyes were as sharp as a hawk, staring at Knox not far away. His whole person exuded an unparalleled powerful aura. When the time came, he would not hesitate to unleash the fatal blow that could determine the outcome!
In an instant, the sword light shone like an electric light, and a fierce sword energy was like a wild horse, running straight towards Knox with lightning speed. This shocking sword was struck by Wang Ping with all his strength. Its power can be said to destroy the world and destroy the earth, unparalleled!
The sword energy flew through the air rapidly, and made a sharp and harsh whistling sound, like an evil ghost crying, and like thousands of horses galloping, deafening.
At this moment, time seemed to be frozen, and everything was at a standstill. Faced with such a terrifying blow, Knox couldn't help but have a trace of unconcealable horror in his eyes. He waved his huge and powerful wings desperately, trying to avoid this fatal sword energy, but it was too late!
Wang Ping's sword energy was so fast that although it failed to hit Knox's head directly, it landed accurately on his broad and solid wings.
I just heard "click"
With a crisp sound, Knox suddenly let out a miserable howl that echoed through the sky. The severe pain from his wings hit him like an overwhelming force, making him almost faint. Due to the loss of the support of his wings, Knox's huge body instantly lost his balance in the air, and fell straight to the ground like a kite with a broken string.
Along with the loud noise, smoke and dust billowed up, covering the sky and the sun. The entire battlefield fell into a dead silence due to this sudden change. Everyone was deeply shocked by this earth-shattering power. Wang Ping stood quietly on the spot, his eyes tightly locked on the direction of Knox's fall, with determination flashing in his eyes. With his unwavering light and resolute look, at this moment, his heart was also filled with endless shock and joy, because he knew that the sword he just swung not only cut off Knox's wings, but also completely cut off the trouble, confusion, and grief and anger that had been lingering in his heart for a long time.
"Master, I... did it"

"I also avenged you, and became the one and only supreme being, the Human Emperor."
"The power of the Human Emperor is very strong. It is so powerful that even if he just steps into the Human Emperor, he can already hold the sun and moon in his hands and cut down all the stars."
